## Scope boundary

This is a personal project with its own corpus. Never read, ingest, quote, or serve TBS data, TBS repos, TBS issues, or TBS MCP server content. Benchmark tasks are drawn from personal-project work only. Boundary tests use synthetic excluded identifiers and never contact excluded systems. The TBS Teaching MCP server is a pattern reference only (hosted, typed tools, live data). Its content is never copied into this repo.
